heading: JSON-typed slots
text:
### JSON-typed slots [LNLS.3.1]

A schema declaration that includes a `json`-typed slot is a compile
error (`DS_VALIDATE_NOLINSCAN_JSON_SLOT`) when the schema is used in a
program with `linear_scan: false`.

Rationale: JSON slot evaluation (`JSON_PATH` expressions) calls
JSON parsing — O(L) with per-node allocation.
